NameMultiLanguage.zh: 理想时光 - 第 51 天

Lines.en: These explosive barrels will raze this land to the ground in an instant.
Lines.zh: 这些炸药桶会将这片土地瞬间夷为平地

Lines.en: No good, there is a huge disturbance in space, and the magnetic field of Kongfu Temple has become chaotic!
Lines.zh: 不好，空间出现巨大扰动，武林寺的磁场已经紊乱！

Lines.en: Super space-time black hole is coming!
Lines.zh: 超级时空黑洞即将到来！
